text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove ran a strong race in the 
Takarazuka Kinen. However, unsatisfied 
with how the race unfolded, she challenged 
Silence Suzuka to a rematch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka embraced Air Groove's 
passionate feelings, and the two exchanged 
a firm handshake.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having watched the Takarazuka Kinen and 
had their fighting spirits ignited, El 
Condor Pasa and Grass Wonder make their 
move to challenge Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With summer training camp just around the 
corner, Silence Suzuka's new battle was 
about to begin.
